payload.title: Which review practice lets a budget-bound run review its final candidate, without a review chain over small changes?
payload.body: Every rival answers this one question. Scenario that separates them: replay a Sonnet runner from the cuts after R-8JQPWG, R-3YJ7T2 and R-JHBCWS (3 trials per rival per cut) and grade lines 1 to 5. Rivals combine only as the named H-combo; the verdicts of the single rivals show which hold alone. No rival may add a stored field or event: whether a candidate is reviewed cannot be derived from the log, so it stays a convention.

why: The one question of issue #141; every candidate fix is a rival under it.

payload.title: H-status-quo: review is its own counted Experiment; findings become limits then fix commits; budget 5
payload.body: The baseline: hyp-goal-run at 9c8e498 (sha256 cb15e2f2...) with hyp prompt's default of 5 Results. Must go red on line 1 or 3 at the cuts, or the instrument has no known answer.

why: A rival of issue #141's question: H-status-quo: review is its own counted Experiment; findings become limits then fix commits; budget 5

payload.title: H-name-at-stop: the stop checkpoint names each candidate without a review
payload.body: Keep the practice and the budget; the stop checkpoint summary lists each commit with no review Result, with its short hash and the word unreviewed. Holds line 1 only by naming.

why: A rival of issue #141's question: H-name-at-stop: the stop checkpoint names each candidate without a review

payload.title: H-one-experiment: a candidate's review is part of its gate Experiment
payload.body: One Experiment and one Result carry the test verdicts and the review's limits, so a candidate costs one Experiment again. The text states how the review is recorded and that it does not count apart.

why: A rival of issue #141's question: H-one-experiment: a candidate's review is part of its gate Experiment

payload.title: H-reserve-last: with one Result left, review the current candidate instead of committing another fix
payload.body: When the stop clause leaves one Result, the runner reviews the current candidate, records its limits and stops, and does not commit another fix.

why: A rival of issue #141's question: H-reserve-last: with one Result left, review the current candidate instead of committing another fix

payload.title: H-raise-budget: the default of --experiments rises to 7
payload.body: Only the stop clause default changes, to 7, to fit a gate and a review per candidate. The text of the practice stays as in H-status-quo.

why: A rival of issue #141's question: H-raise-budget: the default of --experiments rises to 7

payload.title: H-probe-closes: a case the run's probe runs and passes closes in the review's Result, with no commit
payload.body: A case the run's own probe ran and the candidate passed is closed in the review Result, citing the probe log. A limit stays only for a case no check ran or one the candidate fails. Includes the owner's rule R14: a case whose check passes closes as a limit, not with a new commit.

why: A rival of issue #141's question: H-probe-closes: a case the run's probe runs and passes closes in the review's Result, with no commit

payload.title: H-whole-candidate: the review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base
payload.body: The review reads the cumulative diff from the base, not the latest increment. Expected to lose on cost (line 5); the Experiment's rule says so before the replay.

why: A rival of issue #141's question: H-whole-candidate: the review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base

payload.title: H-combo: name-at-stop, reserve-last and probe-closes together
payload.body: The practice texts of H-name-at-stop, H-reserve-last and H-probe-closes together, so the verdicts show which hold alone.

why: A rival of issue #141's question: H-combo: name-at-stop, reserve-last and probe-closes together

payload.summary: Grill done: 5 [N] lines written by owner-standin. One question Q-Q3693W with 8 rivals (status-quo, name-at-stop, one-experiment, reserve-last, raise-budget, probe-closes, whole-candidate, combo); 72 replay trials from 3 cuts. The build change to hyp-goal-run and the stop clause is a later Goal. Carried to it: prompt tests at default 7, how-hyp-improves-itself.md:29 vs prompt.go's 5, Results vs Experiments in the stop clause.
